scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && eslint packages/shared/src eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend backend packages/shared scripts/*.mjs package.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend backend packages/shared scripts/*.mjs package.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
